top_signals.title: Japan's Equities Risk Tactical Correction: Goldman's Moe
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief APAC Regional Equity Strategist Timothy Moe discusses Japan's macroeconomic environment following recent currency market intervention, warning that Japanese stocks risk a tactical pullback. However, he notes corporate earnings will likely remain intact and maintains a bullish view on structural market fundamentals. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New York imports more electricity from Canada after high-voltage transmission line opens
top_signals.summary: On July 3, 2026, the New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) imported 52 gigawatthours (GWh) of electricity from Canada, the most traded between the two areas since January 2025. Some of the imported electricity flowed along the new Champlain Hudson Power Express (CHPE) transmission line between Quebec, Canada, and New York City, which officially reached commercial operations in May after three years of construction.
